scope: 4D's formula editor (EDIT FORMULA, and the Order By editor's Add Formula… and Modify…), published by the native plugin alone from its form's layers: the help line; the Tables, Operators and Commands menus as pop-up buttons; fields, operators and commands as buttons that insert them with a double click; tables and themes of commands as disclosure triangles read from the chevron 4D draws and pressed on it; the formula as an editable text field that is the focused element while it holds 4D's caret; and Load…, Save…, Cancel and OK; a formula built and written through accessibility and returned to the application, which evaluates it; each list a list element holding its lines, read one list at a time; a list longer than its box scrolled a page with AXScrollDownByPage and AXScrollUpByPage, offered to VoiceOver as Scroll down and Scroll up; by AX and by VoiceOver
fixture: prepare_formula_editor_fixture.py and test_formula_editor_fixture.py (Orders table with five records)
checks: the formula editor is pixel-identical to the plugin-free editor
the table's fields are buttons in the Fields list, after the menu that chooses the tables
the operators are buttons in the Operators list, after the menu that chooses their kind
the themes of commands are collapsed disclosure triangles in the Commands list
the formula is a text field holding the formula
Load, Save, Cancel and OK are buttons
writing the formula replaces it
pressing a field inserts it, as its double click does
pressing an operator inserts it
pressing a theme expands it, its commands following it
pressing it again collapses it
a page down scrolls the Commands list to the themes after those it showed, up to its end
a page up scrolls it back
the commands menu lists the commands alphabetically, as buttons
pressing a command inserts it
the tables menu lists the tables, collapsed
pressing a table shows its fields
the formula is written as a keyboard user types it
OK returns the formula, which the application evaluates
VoiceOver reaches the formula editor
VoiceOver reads the Commands list as one list
VoiceOver enters it, and reads a theme of commands as collapsed
VO-Space on it expands it, showing its commands
VoiceOver reads on to the last line the list shows
Scroll down, from VoiceOver's actions menu, scrolls the list a page, to its last themes
VoiceOver enters the list again and reads the themes it scrolled into view
VoiceOver reads the Fields list
VoiceOver enters it and reads the fields
VO-Space on a field inserts it into the formula
VoiceOver reads the formula as an edit field
typing replaces the formula, and VoiceOver echoes it
VoiceOver reaches OK
VO-Space on OK returns the formula, which the application evaluates
